scope: Selected desktop public-demo states. No real authentication, deletion, file storage or payments.

assertions: Real pointer drag changes paper transform; persistence not asserted
Keyboard End/Home reach bounds; extra Right remains clamped at maximum
Click flips and Enter reverses face
Keyboard ArrowLeft reveals actions; Escape closes
Full swipe commits and removes/collapses demo row; no real deletion
Short press returns idle without completing
Menu click opens and Escape closes cards
Non-numeric typed character ignored; 3 numeric slots filled
Six digits produce demo success and lock input
Reject outcome enters error and drains all digits
